caption: The worked example at threshold t = 0.70: the 0.65 attack is scored below the line and missed, so three of four attacks are caught and TPR = 3 ÷ 4 = 0.75. After the 0.80 attack is perturbed to 0.60, only 0.90 and 0.95 are flagged and TPR falls to 2 ÷ 4 = 0.50, while no normal score moves (FPR stays 0).

spec.title: Alert if score ≥ t = 0.70
spec.aria: Three rows of four scores against a threshold of 0.70: four normal scores 0.10, 0.20, 0.35, 0.55 all stay below it; four attack scores 0.65, 0.80, 0.90, 0.95 have the 0.65 missed and three flagged, giving TPR 0.75; a perturbed row with 0.60 in place of 0.80 leaves only two flagged, giving TPR 0.50.
